about: Every number on these slides, with its source. All examples use example data. Live facts were read from public, read-only endpoints and recorded runs on October 30–31, 2026.

claims.source: Tessera's access contract: a tracked anonymous session may claim, heartbeat and submit verbs tagged open:anonymous in the main namespace; the review queue eq03 stays closed to it, and its results wait for a different keyed reviewer.
